opening: If one person raises the order, approves the invoice and releases the payment, who would spot a mistake?
linkedin:
If one person raises the order, approves the invoice and releases the payment, who would spot a mistake?

Segregation of duties means splitting those jobs across different people, so an error or a fraud does not pass through unseen. In a small team, a second review of each payment run is a practical start.

Our audit and risk advisory maps who can do what in your finance process.

Who checks the payments in your business? Tell us in the comments.
